item.title: Stop copy-pasting: WhatsApp trick to send Happy New Year 2026 wishes to hundreds at once
item.description: Want to send your 'Happy New Year' greetings to everyone at once? This hidden WhatsApp feature is a game-changer, allowing you to message hundreds of people simultaneously with just one tap.

item.title: Box Office [Dec 31]: Dhurandhar crosses Rs 720 crore; Avatar 3, TMMTMTTM compete on New Year's Eve
item.description: On New Year's Eve, Dhurandhar managed to crossed the Rs 720 crore mark. Films like Avatar: Fire and Ash earned Rs 5.15 crore, and Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri maintained steady earnings in India.

item.title: BMC Elections 2026: Uddhav Thackeray, Raj Thackeray to address joint rallies from January 5
item.description: BMC Elections 2026: According to sources, the Thackeray brothers will hold three joint rallies in Mumbai's western suburbs and at Shivaji Park. They will also address rallies in Kalyan, Dombivli, and Mira-Bhayandar in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR).

item.title: HSSC Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notification out for 5,500 vacancies; details here
item.description: HSSC Police Constable Recruitment 2026: The HSSC Police Constable application process will begin on January 11, the candidates can apply for HSSC Police Constable post on the official website- hssc.gov.in.

item.title: Indore water contamination: Two officials suspended, one dismissed as death count rises to 13
item.description: Indore water contamination: The deceased include a six-month-old child and six women. The count, however, may rise as 1,300 people are still ill. Of these, more than 100 people are admitted to different hospitals in the city, as their condition remains critical.

item.title: Mohammad Rizwan's flop show continues in BBL, scores 6 runs at strike rate of 60 for Renegades
item.description: Mohammad Rizwan is featuring in the Big Bash League (BBL) at the moment for Melbourne Renegades. However, he hasn't been able to stamp his authority yet in the tournament and his flop show continued in the New Year as well. Rizwan scored only six runs at a strike rate of 60.

item.title: Gold, Silver Rate Today: Silver, gold continue to drop on MCX amid profit booking
item.description: Gold Price Today, Gold MCX Rate: In the international market, the COMEX gold price dropped by 1.24 per cent to approximately USD 4,332.1 per troy ounce.

item.title: Switzerland: Several dead, many injured in explosion at ski resort town of Crans Montana
item.description: Switzerland blast: Initial reports suggest that the blast happened at a bar at a luxury Apline ski resort.

item.title: Vodafone-Idea subscribers shift to rivals; Jio, Airtel, and BSNL see growth in latest TRAI data
item.description: Vodafone Idea's market position has been severely impacted, with the latest TRAI data revealing a loss of over one million subscribers in November. This sharp decline in its user base highlights the growing challenges the company is facing.

item.title: BMC polls: BJP worker submits duplicate AB Form after party denies ticket; Ameet Satam writes to EC
item.description: Shilpa Keluskar was an aspirant from the BJP in Ward No. 137 in Mumbai. However, she was not given the party’s nomination. As a result, she allegedly devised a plan and submitted her nomination by attaching a duplicate AB Form of the party.
